questions.question_text: What is malware, and how does it typically infiltrate a device?

options.text: A type of hardware that boosts internet speed; installed through official stores
Malicious software designed to harm devices; often enters through sketchy links or downloads
A secure app for protecting passwords; installed by default on all devices
A digital currency used by hackers; transferred through online payments

correct_answer.text: Malicious software designed to harm devices; often enters through sketchy links or downloads

questions.question_text: What makes ransomware particularly dangerous for teens?

options.text: It speeds up your device but deletes unimportant files
It locks your device or files and demands payment to unlock them, risking data loss
It improves gaming performance but requires a subscription
It automatically updates apps without user permission

correct_answer.text: It locks your device or files and demands payment to unlock them, risking data loss

questions.question_text: How can you identify a potential phishing attempt in a message or email?

options.text: It comes from a verified account with a blue checkmark and no links
It uses urgent language like “Act now!” and has suspicious links or typos
It offers a free subscription to a trusted app with clear instructions
It includes a personal greeting from someone you know without any requests

correct_answer.text: It uses urgent language like “Act now!” and has suspicious links or typos

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an example of cyberbullying?

options.text: A friend sending you a funny meme in a private chat
Someone repeatedly posting mean comments about you on social media for others to see
A classmate asking for help with homework in a group chat
An app notification reminding you to update your profile picture

correct_answer.text: Someone repeatedly posting mean comments about you on social media for others to see

questions.question_text: What is a recommended step to take if you’re experiencing online harassment or cyberbullying?

options.text: Respond with insults to defend yourself and show strength
Delete all your social media accounts immediately without telling anyone
Save evidence like screenshots, block the person, and tell a trusted adult
Ignore the messages completely and hope they stop on their own

correct_answer.text: Save evidence like screenshots, block the person, and tell a trusted adult

questions.question_text: How can you verify if a viral social media post is fake news or misinformation?

options.text: Share it immediately to see if others agree it’s true
Check the source, cross-check with trusted news outlets, and use fact-checking sites
Trust the post if it has a lot of likes and comments
Assume it’s real if it matches your personal opinions

correct_answer.text: Check the source, cross-check with trusted news outlets, and use fact-checking sites
